notes: This source/test traceability contract covers only Umbra's bounded regular Attribute Ownership Acquisition path in the opt-in, non-installable IEEE 1516.1-2025 development profile: private Acquisition Pending state, the owner-side Request Attribute Ownership Release callback, callback-time notification for an unowned attribute, the Attribute Ownership Release Denied terminal response, and a separate pending cancellation reservation that ends at Confirm Attribute Ownership Acquisition Cancellation. The regular request overrides the invoking federate's still-pending If Available reservation for the same attribute and preserves an existing regular pending attribute on repeat without a duplicate release callback. Both regular acquisition and accepted cancellation retain requester publication until their terminal callback, and Unpublish Object Class Attributes therefore raises OwnershipAcquisitionPending. A release denial preserves current ownership, terminates all matching regular pending acquisitions, and delivers Attribute Ownership Unavailable with the denial tag. A bounded cancellation accepts only a still-pending regular request, suppresses stale notification/release work, and confirms all qualifying attributes in one callback. The owner-denial in-flight cancellation race now produces the third-form Attribute Ownership Unavailable outcome, and a competing Divestiture If Wanted transfer consumes the queued cancellation reservation so the second-form Attribute Ownership Acquisition Notification wins without a duplicate confirmation. The contract uses immutable candidate IDs from the Requirements Lab and follows their exported clause IDs; RL-015 records the ownership-page attribution mismatch. Every remaining divestiture form, acquisition arbitration beyond the tested bounded scheduler behavior, RTI-owned state, full resign-action disposition, save/restore behavior, DDM, timestamped/retraction behavior, FOM sharing policy, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
